svg.title: Bridge architecture
svg.desc: Bridge architecture — Claude Code and Codex, two directions over one shared supervisor, MCP surface, setup lifecycle, permissions and workspace binding
svg.text: Claude Code ↔ Codex — each host's own engine, one shared supervisor in the middle
unlabeled arrow = block finished, next block starts · pills name every condition · results return along the same arrows

g.text: your own CLIs are the engines

text.tspan: each host can call the other

svg.text: target=peer · approval-bound · no model in the loop

g.text: One result shape for both directions

text.tspan: Codex thread ID ≠ Claude session ID

g.text: no edit, auth or paid consent
Refused folders — typed or proposed alike
What the picture does not promise

svg.text: Non-normative architecture overview. The shipped source wins on any disagreement:
Update this file in the same commit that changes a transport, tool, setup step or binding rule it shows.
